question: In a certain code language, 'MUSIC' is written as 'LTTJD', and 'CONCEPT' is written as 'BNMDFQU'. How will 'SINGING' be written in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e36ccc9135aaf5c2b965004d10d5769eb93a0c1743407f3050a22204a0c10a2.png] 
 
• Code for the first 2 letters out of 5 = Positional value - 1
 
• Code for the remaining letters = Positional value + 1
